adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the backfill inserts rows via raw SQL: `INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)` for each `h` from `val.split("\n")`. This bypasses the EmbeddableHost model’s `before_validation` normalization (stripping http/https and paths) and any format validations, so values like `http://example.com`, `https://example.com/123`, trailing `\r`, whitespace, or blank lines can be persisted as-is (empty string is allowed by the DB `null: false`). Later lookups use `record_for_host` -> `URI(url).host` and `where("lower(host) = ?", host)`, which will not match entries stored with schemes/paths/CR, causing migrated allowed-hosts to stop working.
